## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Related issue

Closes #

## Type of change

- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Research or experiment
- [ ] Refactor or maintenance

## How to verify

List the commands and manual steps a reviewer should use.

## Evidence

Add screenshots, logs, test results, or evaluation results when useful.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and linked to an issue.
- [ ] I reviewed my own diff.
- [ ] Tests were added or updated, or I explained why they are not needed.
- [ ] Documentation and `.env.example` were updated where needed.
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, large datasets, or generated artifacts were committed.
- [ ] Agent or prompt changes include evaluation evidence and failure behaviour.
- [ ] I considered privacy, security, accessibility, cost, and latency impacts.
